audit.why: Even matchup at 49.39% over 5262 games; Ahri owns levels 1-4 on range and Charm, Akali takes over from 6/first item. Chart matches the win rate and the kits, so no chart flips proposed.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] framed Ahri's level 6 vaguely; the actual spike is Charm at 975 range interrupting Akali's dashes, and spikes[0] invented a 'Fox-Fire proc on Q'.
audit.why: Riot's Charm text: 'instantly stopping movement abilities'. That is what makes her 6 (and her 12s Charm generally) the decisive spike against a dash assassin. Fox-Fire has no interaction with Orb of Deception.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[0] around Orb of Deception's true-damage return and spikes[1] around Charm cancelling E/R.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] told the player to juke Charm with W. Twilight Shroud makes Akali unselectable by spells and attacks — it stops Ahri's Fox-Fire lock-on, but Charm and Orb are skillshots and still land. The page also never stated that Charm stops movement abilities, which is the single decisive interaction here.
audit.why: Ownerkit W: 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks'. Enemy W: fox-fires 'lock onto' nearby enemies — that targeting is what the shroud denies. Enemy E stops movement abilities, i.e. it cancels Akali's E dash and R dash.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] and breakdown.cooldowns now state: Shroud kills Fox-Fire's lock-on, not skillshots; never E or R into an available Charm.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal note despite Essence Theft, and no note that Orb's return damage is true damage.
audit.why: missingInteractions flagged both: needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated.
audit.corrected: Itemization now names Ignite against Essence Theft; spikes[0] states the true-damage return so MR is not the answer.

audit.why: Charm is a flat 12s at all ranks; Twilight Shroud is 20s at rank 1. Concrete counts beat 'count it out loud'.
packet flagged 'Use Spirit Rush' in wants.foe[2] as a suspect name — it is a FALSE POSITIVE. Spirit Rush is Ahri's real R name in the kit file. No edit made.

edits.before: Ahri's Charm-into-Orb-of-Deception poke chunks you before you can safely flip in with E, and her Fox-Fire proc on Q punishes any wave trade you attempt.
edits.after: Ahri's Orb of Deception poke chunks you before you can safely flip in with E, and the return half is true damage, so early MR does nothing to soften the trade.

edits.before: Ahri 6 threatens a Charm into full-combo pattern from range that your Shroud can't dodge once the Charm actually lands, making this her strongest all-in window.
edits.after: Ahri 6 threatens Charm from 975 range into full combo, and Charm instantly stops movement abilities — it cancels your E dash or R mid-flight, so this is her strongest window.

edits.before: Bait her Charm onto a minion or juke it with W before you commit
edits.after: Bait Charm onto a minion — Shroud stops Fox-Fire, not skillshots

edits.before: - Ahri Charm: matchup-defining — The charm starts every kill pattern — stay behind minions while it is up. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Twilight Shroud has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Charm: a flat 12s at every rank and matchup-defining — it instantly stops movement abilities, so never E or R into a loaded Charm; hold behind minions until it is spent. - Twilight Shroud (20s at rank 1) breaks Fox-Fire's lock-on. - The R is for endings.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — one carry per fight, every fight; the shroud buys the time and the resets pay the exit.
edits.after: Carry by deleting Ahri herself: no peel once Charm is spent, and her 100s Spirit Rush cannot outrun your R recasts.

edits.before: If Ahri opens the score, reset expectations and respect Charm doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q range and stay relevant through shroud picks.
edits.after: If Ahri opens the score, Essence Theft heals her back off the wave, so chip is wasted — farm at Q range, hold shroud for her Charm follow-up, and fight only with Ignite up.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield or Ring + pots. Riftmaker or Stormsurge-line first, Sorcerer's/Mercs, then Zhonya's into burst, Rabadon's after.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pots. Stormsurge or Riftmaker first, Sorcerer's, Zhonya's into her burst, Rabadon's after; Ignite answers Essence Theft.

notes: Suspect name 'Use Spirit Rush' (wants.foe[2]) is a false positive — Spirit Rush is correct. Level chart agrees across full and content layers already; no chart edits proposed. breakdown.wave and ahead read templated but Ahri gives nothing specific enough to ground a replacement without inventing, so they were left.
